item_short_desc: Rothco’s Rechargeable 600 Lumen LED Headlamp is your go-to headlamp for work, camping, hiking, and emergency situations, with a convenient motion sensor that enables hands-free illumination. This headlamp has been carefully engineered for lengthy excursions; the lightweight design, 3-way head strap, and 90-degree tilt help distribute weight and reduce neck fatigue. The LED headlamp features 5 light modes: High, low, red, lantern, and strobe. A central CPE LED light and 2 COB LED side lights provide a wide range of illumination.
description: Rothco’s Rechargeable 600 Lumen LED Headlamp is perfect for work and the great outdoors with a convenient motion sensor that enables hands-free illumination. The LED headlamp features 5 light modes: High, low, red, lantern, and strobe. A central CPE LED light and 2 COB LED side lights provide a wide range of illumination. 90-degree tiltability on the headlamp flashlight helps reduce head fatigue. The lightweight headlamp features a high-quality ABS plastic body and has a 3-6-hour runtime (Micro USB charging cable included). The powerful 600 lumen headlamp shines for about 150 feet (50 meters) on high mode and features a 3-way head strap that is comfortable on bare heads and compatible with hard hats. The Flashlight headlamp measures 3 inches X 2 inches X 1.5 inches and is IP4X water and dust-resistant.
